text: The Reserve Bank of Australia raises its cash rate 25 basis points to 4.6%, its fourth increase of 2026 and the highest level in 15 years. Inflation remains above the 2%-3% target band, while the RBA retains further rate increases within its policy range.

meta.note: Forward policy optionality is retained only as a stated boundary condition.

text: Oura postpones its planned Nasdaq IPO after formally launching the offering process on Sept. 21. The proposed sale covered 50 million shares and up to $2.2 billion. Oura remains privately held and reports profitability alongside 90% expected FY2026 revenue growth.

meta.note: The offering is postponed rather than withdrawn permanently.

text: Alaska expands premium seatingn across Alaska and Hawaiian fleets while reducing total seats on Hawaiian A330s. New premium-economy, lie-flat suite and dedicated lounge capacity spans both brands, which remain separately operated.

meta.note: Fleet, lounge and loyalty changes share one premium-capacity configuration but span multiple operating surfaces.

text: The 30-year Treasury yield reaches 5.613%, its highest level since 2002, while the 10-year reaches 5.285%. The 2-year remains near 4.922%, widening the separation between long- and short-duration Treasury yields.

meta.note: The event records the yield configuration only; reported drivers and rate expectations are excluded.

text: OpenAI introduces Dots, GPT-6.1 Sol, collaborative Spaces and Pages, plugin extensions, Ultrafast processing and private inference at DevDay. Agents, models, applications, human collaboration and developer tooling occupy a shared ChatGPT-centered platform.

meta.note: More than 20 releases share one platform surface but span distinct product functions.

text: President Trump and technology leaders sign a voluntary AI statement of principles described by Trump as "morally binding." The White House retains government guidance alongside industry self-regulation, with a 10-person oversight committee under consideration.

meta.note: The agreement's reported voluntary status limits classification as formal regulatory containment.
